key_result: Node-level extraction exceeds 98.5% accuracy on most metrics; address classification reaches 50.49% top-1 on raw graphs and 72.43% top-3 with engineered features.
takeaway: Tests five language models on Bitcoin transaction graphs, using a compact graph format and a sampling method to fit context limits.
title: Large Language Models for Cryptocurrency Transaction Analysis: A Bitcoin Case Study
why_it_matters: It measures where language models help with transaction analysis and where global graph reasoning breaks down.
